name: What is the process for an outdated-room modernization project with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for an outdated-room modernization project with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for an outdated-room modernization project begins with a complimentary initial consultation. During this meeting, we discuss your vision, budget, and specific needs for the room. Next, we develop a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, timeline, and cost. Upon approval, we handle all necessary permits, if applicable, and begin the construction phase. Throughout the project, we maintain clear communication, provide regular updates, and ensure minimal disruption to your daily life. Our goal is to deliver a seamless experience from conception to completion. We also conduct a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction with the modernized space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process starts with a consultation, followed by a detailed proposal, permit acquisition, and construction with ongoing communication. We ensure minimal disruption and complete client satisfaction through a final walkthrough.
